Figure 15: LoCoMo case for Caroline’s book recommendation. Evidence: Caroline says she loved Becoming Nicole by Amy Ellis Nutt and highly recommends it. The enhanced answer corrects the title to Becoming Nicole.

Figure 14: LoCoMo case for Gina’s accepted professional experience. Evidence: Gina says she got accepted for a fashion internship; the design internship is only an earlier interview. The enhanced answer changes design internship to fashion internship.
Table 2: Short-form single-page QA on Qwen3-VL-8B. Each cell shows the metric followed by its relative change (%) vs. Plain VQA. Avg. text tokens ≈ 805 (∼ 3× compression).

Figure 16: LongBench HotpotQA case asking whether Duke Energy and Affiliated Managers Group are both based in Massachusetts. Evidence: Duke Energy is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, so the conjunction is false even though Affiliated Managers Group has a Massachusetts office. The enhanced answer changes Yes to No.

Figure 17: LongBench MuSiQue case linking Rain Is a Good Thing to Home Alone Tonight. Evidence: Rain Is a Good Thing is by Luke Bryan, and Home Alone Tonight is Luke Bryan’s duet with Karen Fairchild. The enhanced answer changes Luke Bryan to Karen Fairchild.

Table 4: Dataset statistics for the three benchmark families used in §5. Avg. chars and Avg. words are the per-sample mean character and whitespace-separated word counts of the textual context T before rendering. All datasets are used consistently with their licenses for non-commercial academic research.
Table 5: InternVL3.5-8B short-form QA (F1).

Table 11: Layer-range aggregated NDCG (mean over n=100 samples per cell). Each cell is the NDCG of last-token attention, head-averaged and then pooled over the specified depth range. The Late (50–100%) pool dominates in every (model, dataset) cell.
Figure 9: Per-head NDCG of last-token attention to evidence tokens on NQ / TriviaQA / NewsQA (appendix companion to Fig. 2).

Figure 18: LongBench NarrativeQA case on Anthony Rogers’s 1927 business. Evidence: the story says his company was the American Corporation. The enhanced answer gives the requested business type, radioactive gas, instead of the broader name.

Figure 7: Full (k, α) sweep on 12 subtasks. 3D bar version. Short-form QA (top row): NQ / HotpotQA / NewsQA / TQA. LongBench multi-page (middle row): LB-HQA / LB-2WMQA / LB-MSQ / LB-QP. LoCoMo multi-page memory (bottom row): SingleHop / MultiHop / Temporal / OpenDomain.

Figure 5: AGAR robustness on Qwen3-VL-8B / HotpotQA. Blue: Plain F1; orange: AGAR F1; box: absolute and relative ∆. (a)–(c): visual corruptions (downsampling, Gaussian noise, blur). (d): text-side dilution from L0 (gold only) to L4 (66 paragraphs, with hard negatives at L2–L4).

Figure 11: Fixed readable-size enlargement on Qwen3-VL-8B under vision-token compression. Blue: PLAINVQA F1; red: FIXED F1. Panel (a) compares the Qwen PLAINVQA baseline at 3× compression (9 px) with FIXED under the same rendering, where fixed 13.5 px equals scale 1.5×; panels (b) and (c) show FIXED at 5× compression (5 px) and 10× compression (3 px). Boxes report absolute and relative ∆F1 plus vision-token cost.

Figure 10: Per-head NDCG vs. head rank for the same four VLMs × four datasets as Fig. 9. Each curve sorts the (layer, head) heads by mean NDCG (descending) on a log-scale rank axis; the steep drop near the top and slow decay toward the median quantify the head-population structure visible in the layer× head heatmaps.

Figure 22: HotpotQA case on the actor shared by The True Adventures of Wolfboy and The Knick. Evidence: Wolfboy stars Eve Hewson, and Eve Hewson played Nurse Lucy Elkins in The Knick. The enhanced answer recovers Eve Hewson from the plain no-answer response.

Figure 21: NewsQA case on the autopsy result. Evidence: the initial necropsy, or animal autopsy, found Nico’s cause of death inconclusive. The enhanced answer changes the plain no-answer response to inconclusive.

Figure 12: Relative-scale enlargement on Qwen3-VL-8B under vision-token compression. Blue: PLAINVQA F1; green: RELATIVE F1. Panel (a) shows RELATIVE on the original 27 px rendering; panels (b) and (c) show RELATIVE at 5× compression (5 px) and 10× compression (3 px). Boxes report absolute and relative ∆F1 plus vision-token cost.
Figure 13: LoCoMo case for James’s 2021 trip. Evidence: in a March 2022 dialogue, James says he visited Italy last year, while Japan is John’s later trip. The enhanced answer changes Japan to Italy.
